articles.summary: On October 6, 2026, a change we enabled caused our Vercel integration to overwrite some environment variable values with empty strings. Tasks that needed those values started failing.
articles.title: Vercel environment variables cleared during synchronization

articles.summary: We upgraded to Zod 4 and worker CPU dropped by nearly a third. One hot path does about 98 million parses a day. We're now Zod's first Platinum Sponsor.
articles.title: Zod 4 got rid of a bunch of CPUs for us
